$comment: Three-outcome benchmark for `find` (diddit #4163, Peter 2026-10-20: exact = short-circuit on the biggest component that covers the need; cousin = keep searching, then the nearest as a placeholder plus a gap record; none = a GapBox placeholder plus a gap record). Needs are posited around components we KNOW satisfy each case. `expect` is the component(s) that count as the right pick (exact: the biggest covering component first; cousin: the nearest existing export). `gap` is the name a cousin / none record should carry. Frozen in its own commit before any classifier code exists; the labels are never edited to make a case pass.
